*   **When to use:** When hardware acceleration is available and exponential transparency is required to avoid artifacts [S1][S2, unofficial][S3, unofficial].

The evidence in all three sources (S1, S2, S3) explicitly states that linear interpolation of transparency/opacity causes 'Mach bands' due to the non-linear nature of the exponential transparency function. They further explain that using hardware texture mapping (table lookup) allows for the computation of the exponential term per pixel, thereby avoiding these artifacts. This method relies on hardware acceleration (texture mapping/interpolation) and is recommended when exponential transparency is required to maintain visual quality.
